script: 你好！｜你好！
reading: Nǐ hǎo! | Nǐ hǎo!
english: Hello! | Hello!
gloss: مَرْحَبًا! | مَرْحَبًا!
gloss_reading: Marḥaban! | Marḥaban!

script: 你好吗？｜我很好，谢谢。你呢？｜我很好。
reading: Nǐ hǎo ma? | Wǒ hěn hǎo, xiè xie. Nǐ ne? | Wǒ hěn hǎo.
english: How are you? | I'm fine, thanks. And you? | I'm fine.
gloss: كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ | أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، شُكْرًا. وَأَنْتَ؟ | أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ.
gloss_reading: Kayfa ḥāluk? | Anā bikhayr, shukran. Waʾant? | Anā bikhayr.

script: 你们好！｜你好！
reading: Nǐ men hǎo! | Nǐ hǎo!
english: Hello, everyone! | Hello!
gloss: مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ جَمِيعًا! | مَرْحَبًا!
gloss_reading: Marḥaban bikum jamīʿan! | Marḥaban!

script: 你在哪儿？｜我在这儿！
reading: Nǐ zài nǎr? | Wǒ zài zhèr!
english: Where are you? | I'm here!
gloss: أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ | أَنَا هُنَا!
gloss_reading: Ayna anta? | Anā hunā!

script: 谁在那儿？｜是我！
reading: Shéi zài nàr? | Shì wǒ!
english: Who's there? | It's me!
gloss: مَنْ هُنَاكَ؟ | أَنَا!
gloss_reading: Man hunāk? | Anā!

script: 你在做什么？｜我在吃东西。
reading: Nǐ zài zuò shén me? | Wǒ zài chī dōng xi.
english: What are you doing? | I'm eating.
gloss: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ؟ | أَنَا آكُلُ.
gloss_reading: Mādhā tafʿal? | Anā ākul.

script: 你在看什么？｜我在看你。
reading: Nǐ zài kàn shén me? | Wǒ zài kàn nǐ.
english: What are you looking at? | I'm looking at you.
gloss: إِلَى مَاذَا تَنْظُرُ؟ | أَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْكَ.
gloss_reading: Ilā mādhā tanẓur? | Anā anẓuru ilayk.

script: 你认识他吗？｜我不认识他。
reading: Nǐ rèn shi tā ma? | Wǒ bú rèn shi tā.
english: Do you know him? | I don't know him.
gloss: هَلْ تَعْرِفُهُ؟ | لَا أَعْرِفُهُ.
gloss_reading: Hal taʿrifuh? | Lā aʿrifuh.

script: 他是谁？｜他是我的朋友。
reading: Tā shì shéi? | Tā shì wǒ de péng you.
english: Who is he? | He is my friend.
gloss: مَنْ هُوَ؟ | هُوَ صَدِيقِي.
gloss_reading: Man huwa? | Huwa ṣadīqī.

script: 我们是朋友吗？｜是的！我们是朋友。
reading: Wǒ men shì péng you ma? | Shì de! Wǒ men shì péng you.
english: Are we friends? | Yes! We are friends.
gloss: هَلْ نَحْنُ أَصْدِقَاءُ؟ | نَعَمْ! نَحْنُ أَصْدِقَاءُ.
gloss_reading: Hal naḥnu aṣdiqāʾ? | Naʿam! Naḥnu aṣdiqāʾ.

script: 你有朋友吗？｜有，你是我的朋友。
reading: Nǐ yǒu péng you ma? | Yǒu, nǐ shì wǒ de péng you.
english: Do you have friends? | Yes, you're my friend.
gloss: هَلْ لَدَيْكَ أَصْدِقَاءُ؟ | نَعَمْ، أَنْتَ صَدِيقِي.
gloss_reading: Hal ladayka aṣdiqāʾ? | Naʿam, anta ṣadīqī.

script: 再见！｜明天见！
reading: Zài jiàn! | Míng tiān jiàn!
english: Goodbye! | See you tomorrow!
gloss: مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ! | أَرَاكَ غَدًا!
gloss_reading: Maʿa as-salāma! | Arāka ghadan!

script: 谢谢你！｜不客气。
reading: Xiè xie nǐ! | Bú kè qi.
english: Thank you! | You're welcome.
gloss: شُكْرًا لَكَ! | عَفْوًا.
gloss_reading: Shukran lak! | ʿAfwan.

script: 对不起！｜没关系。
reading: Duì bu qǐ! | Méi guān xi.
english: Sorry! | It's okay.
gloss: آسِفٌ! | لَا بَأْسَ.
gloss_reading: Āsif! | Lā baʾs.

script: 你好漂亮！｜谢谢！
reading: Nǐ hǎo piào liang! | Xiè xie!
english: You're so pretty! | Thanks!
gloss: أَنْتَ جَمِيلٌ جِدًّا! | شُكْرًا!
gloss_reading: Anta jamīlun jiddan! | Shukran!

script: 你的衣服很漂亮。｜谢谢你！
reading: Nǐ de yī fu hěn piào liang. | Xiè xie nǐ!
english: Your clothes are very pretty. | Thank you!
gloss: مَلَابِسُكَ جَمِيلَةٌ جِدًّا. | شُكْرًا لَكَ!
gloss_reading: Malābisuka jamīlatun jiddan. | Shukran lak!

script: 我爱你。｜谢谢！我很高兴。
reading: Wǒ ài nǐ. | Xiè xie! Wǒ hěn gāo xìng.
english: I love you. | Thanks! I'm very happy.
gloss: أُحِبُّكَ. | شُكْرًا! أَنَا سَعِيدٌ جِدًّا.
gloss_reading: Uḥibbuk. | Shukran! Anā saʿīdun jiddan.

script: 你喜欢这儿吗？｜我很喜欢这儿。
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan zhèr ma? | Wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhèr.
english: Do you like it here? | I like it here very much.
gloss: هَلْ تُحِبُّ هٰذَا الْمَكَانَ؟ | أُحِبُّهُ كَثِيرًا.
gloss_reading: Hal tuḥibbu hādhā al-makān? | Uḥibbuhu kathīran.

script: 你想吃什么？｜我想吃米饭。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng chī shén me? | Wǒ xiǎng chī mǐ fàn.
english: What do you want to eat? | I want to eat rice.
gloss: مَاذَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ؟ | أُرِيدُ أَنْ آكُلَ أُرُزًّا.
gloss_reading: Mādhā turīdu an taʾkul? | Urīdu an ākula uruzzan.

script: 你吃饭了吗？｜我没有吃饭。｜我们去吃饭。
reading: Nǐ chī fàn le ma? | Wǒ méi yǒu chī fàn. | Wǒ men qù chī fàn.
english: Have you eaten? | I haven't eaten. | Let's go and eat.
gloss: هَلْ أَكَلْتَ؟ | لَمْ آكُلْ. | لِنَذْهَبْ لِنَأْكُلَ.
gloss_reading: Hal akalt? | Lam ākul. | Linadhhab linaʾkul.

script: 我想吃东西。｜这儿有苹果。｜谢谢！
reading: Wǒ xiǎng chī dōng xi. | Zhèr yǒu píng guǒ. | Xiè xie!
english: I want to eat something. | There are apples here. | Thanks!
gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ آكُلَ شَيْئًا. | هُنَا تُفَّاحٌ. | شُكْرًا!
gloss_reading: Urīdu an ākula shayʾan. | Hunā tuffāḥ. | Shukran!

script: 这是什么？｜这是苹果。｜我能吃吗？｜能！
reading: Zhè shì shén me? | Zhè shì píng guǒ. | Wǒ néng chī ma? | Néng!
english: What is this? | This is an apple. | Can I eat it? | Yes!
gloss: مَا هٰذَا؟ | هٰذَا تُفَّاحٌ. | هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ آكُلَهُ؟ | نَعَمْ!
gloss_reading: Mā hādhā? | Hādhā tuffāḥ. | Hal yumkinunī an ākulah? | Naʿam!

script: 这个好吃吗？｜很好吃！
reading: Zhè ge hǎo chī ma? | Hěn hǎo chī!
english: Is this tasty? | Very tasty!
gloss: هَلْ هٰذَا لَذِيذٌ؟ | لَذِيذٌ جِدًّا!
gloss_reading: Hal hādhā ladhīdh? | Ladhīdhun jiddan!

script: 你喜欢什么水果？｜我喜欢苹果。
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan shén me shuǐ guǒ? | Wǒ xǐ huan píng guǒ.
english: What fruit do you like? | I like apples.
gloss: أَيُّ فَاكِهَةٍ تُحِبُّ؟ | أُحِبُّ التُّفَّاحَ.
gloss_reading: Ayyu fākihatin tuḥibb? | Uḥibbu at-tuffāḥ.

script: 你想喝什么？｜我想喝茶。｜好的。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng hē shén me? | Wǒ xiǎng hē chá. | Hǎo de.
english: What would you like to drink? | I'd like tea. | Okay.
gloss: مَاذَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَشْرَبَ؟ | أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشْرَبَ شَايًا. | حَسَنًا.
gloss_reading: Mādhā turīdu an tashrab? | Urīdu an ashraba shāyan. | Ḥasanan.

script: 请喝茶。｜谢谢，我很喜欢喝茶。
reading: Qǐng hē chá. | Xiè xie, wǒ hěn xǐ huan hē chá.
english: Please have some tea. | Thanks, I really like tea.
gloss: تَفَضَّلْ بِالشَّايِ. | شُكْرًا، أَنَا أُحِبُّ الشَّايَ كَثِيرًا.
gloss_reading: Tafaḍḍal bi-sh-shāy. | Shukran, anā uḥibbu ash-shāya kathīran.

script: 你喜欢吃中国菜吗？｜很喜欢！
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan chī zhōng guó cài ma? | Hěn xǐ huan!
english: Do you like Chinese food? | Very much!
gloss: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ الصِّينِيَّ؟ | أُحِبُّهُ كَثِيرًا!
gloss_reading: Hal tuḥibbu aṭ-ṭaʿāma aṣ-ṣīniyy? | Uḥibbuhu kathīran!

script: 中午吃什么？｜吃米饭。
reading: Zhōng wǔ chī shén me? | Chī mǐ fàn.
english: What's for lunch? | Rice.
gloss: مَاذَا سَنَأْكُلُ لِلْغَدَاءِ؟ | أَرُزًّا.
gloss_reading: Mādhā sanaʾkulu li-l-ghadāʾ? | Aruzzan.
note: reviewer proposed a fix (عَلَى الْغَدَاءِ is colloquial; أُرُزٌّ vowelling nonstandard, use أَرُزًّا); blind reading was "What are we eating for lunch? | Rice." · re-check next round

script: 你想睡觉吗？｜我很想睡觉。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng shuì jiào ma? | Wǒ hěn xiǎng shuì jiào.
english: Do you want to sleep? | I really want to sleep.
gloss: هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَنَامَ؟ | أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنَامَ بِشِدَّةٍ.
gloss_reading: Hal turīdu an tanām? | Urīdu an anāma bishidda.

script: 你睡觉了吗？｜没有。
reading: Nǐ shuì jiào le ma? | Méi yǒu.
english: Have you gone to bed? | No.
gloss: هَلْ نِمْتَ؟ | لَا.
gloss_reading: Hal nimt? | Lā.

script: 现在几点？｜现在三点。｜我想睡觉了。
reading: Xiàn zài jǐ diǎn? | Xiàn zài sān diǎn. | Wǒ xiǎng shuì jiào le.
english: What time is it? | It's three o'clock. | I want to sleep now.
gloss: كَمِ السَّاعَةُ الْآنَ؟ | السَّاعَةُ الْآنَ الثَّالِثَةُ. | أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنَامَ الْآنَ.
gloss_reading: Kami as-sāʿatu al-ʾān? | As-sāʿatu al-ʾāna ath-thālitha. | Urīdu an anāma al-ʾān.

script: 你想回家吗？｜想，我想睡觉。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng huí jiā ma? | Xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng shuì jiào.
english: Do you want to go home? | Yes, I want to sleep.
gloss: هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَعُودَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ؟ | نَعَمْ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنَامَ.
gloss_reading: Hal turīdu an taʿūda ilā al-bayt? | Naʿam, urīdu an anām.

script: 今天天气怎么样？｜今天很热。
reading: Jīn tiān tiān qì zěn me yàng? | Jīn tiān hěn rè.
english: How's the weather today? | It's hot today.
gloss: كَيْفَ الطَّقْسُ الْيَوْمَ؟ | الطَّقْسُ حَارٌّ الْيَوْمَ.
gloss_reading: Kayfa aṭ-ṭaqsu al-yawm? | Aṭ-ṭaqsu ḥārrun al-yawm.

script: 今天很冷。｜是的，太冷了！
reading: Jīn tiān hěn lěng. | Shì de, tài lěng le!
english: It's cold today. | Yes, it's too cold!
gloss: الطَّقْسُ بَارِدٌ الْيَوْمَ. | نَعَمْ، بَارِدٌ جِدًّا!
gloss_reading: Aṭ-ṭaqsu bāridun al-yawm. | Naʿam, bāridun jiddan!

script: 明天会下雨吗？｜会。
reading: Míng tiān huì xià yǔ ma? | Huì.
english: Will it rain tomorrow? | It will.
gloss: هَلْ سَتُمْطِرُ غَدًا؟ | نَعَمْ.
gloss_reading: Hal satumṭiru ghadan? | Naʿam.

script: 下雨了！｜我们回家。
reading: Xià yǔ le! | Wǒ men huí jiā.
english: It's raining! | We're going home.
gloss: إِنَّهَا تُمْطِرُ! | نَحْنُ نَعُودُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ.
gloss_reading: Innahā tumṭir! | Naḥnu naʿūdu ilā al-bayt.

script: 你冷吗？｜我很冷。
reading: Nǐ lěng ma? | Wǒ hěn lěng.
english: Are you cold? | I'm very cold.
gloss: هَلْ تَشْعُرُ بِالْبَرْدِ؟ | أَشْعُرُ بِبَرْدٍ شَدِيدٍ.
gloss_reading: Hal tashʿuru bi-l-bard? | Ashʿuru bibardin shadīd.

script: 你热吗？｜不热。
reading: Nǐ rè ma? | Bú rè.
english: Are you hot? | No.
gloss: هَلْ تَشْعُرُ بِالْحَرِّ؟ | لَا.
gloss_reading: Hal tashʿuru bi-l-ḥarr? | Lā.

script: 你去哪儿？｜我去商店。｜你想买什么？｜我想买苹果。
reading: Nǐ qù nǎr? | Wǒ qù shāng diàn. | Nǐ xiǎng mǎi shén me? | Wǒ xiǎng mǎi píng guǒ.
english: Where are you going? | I'm going to the shop. | What do you want to buy? | I want to buy apples.
gloss: إِلَى أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ؟ | أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَتْجَرِ. | مَاذَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ؟ | أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشْتَرِيَ تُفَّاحًا.
gloss_reading: Ilā ayna tadhhab? | Adhhabu ilā al-matjar. | Mādhā turīdu an tashtariy? | Urīdu an ashtariya tuffāḥan.

script: 这个多少钱？｜三块钱。｜太多了！
reading: Zhè ge duō shao qián? | Sān kuài qián. | Tài duō le!
english: How much is this? | Three yuan. | That's too much!
gloss: بِكَمْ هٰذَا؟ | بِثَلَاثَةِ يُوَانَاتٍ. | هٰذَا كَثِيرٌ جِدًّا!
gloss_reading: Bikam hādhā? | Bithalāthati yuwānāt. | Hādhā kathīrun jiddan!

script: 你几岁？｜我八岁。你呢？｜我九岁。
reading: Nǐ jǐ suì? | Wǒ bā suì. Nǐ ne? | Wǒ jiǔ suì.
english: How old are you? | I'm eight. And you? | I'm nine.
gloss: كَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟ | عُمْرِي ثَمَانِي سَنَوَاتٍ. وَأَنْتَ؟ | عُمْرِي تِسْعُ سَنَوَاتٍ.
gloss_reading: Kam ʿumruk? | ʿUmrī thamānī sanawāt. Waʾant? | ʿUmrī tisʿu sanawāt.

script: 你家有几个人？｜我家有五个人。
reading: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ gè rén? | Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ gè rén.
english: How many people are in your family? | There are five people in my family.
gloss: كَمْ فَرْدًا فِي عَائِلَتِكَ؟ | فِي عَائِلَتِي خَمْسَةُ أَفْرَادٍ.
gloss_reading: Kam fardan fī ʿāʾilatik? | Fī ʿāʾilatī khamsatu afrād.

script: 你会说汉语吗？｜我会说一点儿。
reading: Nǐ huì shuō hàn yǔ ma? | Wǒ huì shuō yì diǎnr.
english: Can you speak Chinese? | I can speak a little.
gloss: هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَتَكَلَّمَ الصِّينِيَّةَ؟ | أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ قَلِيلًا.
gloss_reading: Hal tastaṭīʿu an tatakallama aṣ-ṣīniyya? | Astaṭīʿu an atakallama qalīlan.

script: 你在学习汉语吗？｜是的，汉语很好。
reading: Nǐ zài xué xí hàn yǔ ma? | Shì de, hàn yǔ hěn hǎo.
english: Are you studying Chinese? | Yes, Chinese is great.
gloss: هَلْ تَدْرُسُ الصِّينِيَّةَ؟ | نَعَمْ، الصِّينِيَّةُ رَائِعَةٌ.
gloss_reading: Hal tadrusu aṣ-ṣīniyya? | Naʿam, aṣ-ṣīniyyatu rāʾiʿa.

script: 你会写这个字吗？｜我不会。
reading: Nǐ huì xiě zhè ge zì ma? | Wǒ bú huì.
english: Can you write this character? | I can't.
gloss: هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَكْتُبَ هٰذَا الْحَرْفَ الصِّينِيَّ؟ | لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ.
gloss_reading: Hal tastaṭīʿu an taktuba hādhā al-ḥarfa aṣ-ṣīniyy? | Lā astaṭīʿ.

script: 你是老师吗？｜不是，我是学生。
reading: Nǐ shì lǎo shī ma? | Bú shì, wǒ shì xué sheng.
english: Are you a teacher? | No, I'm a student.
gloss: هَلْ أَنْتَ مُعَلِّمٌ؟ | لَا، أَنَا طَالِبٌ.
gloss_reading: Hal anta muʿallim? | Lā, anā ṭālib.

script: 今天是星期几？｜今天星期六。｜太好了！
reading: Jīn tiān shì xīng qī jǐ? | Jīn tiān xīng qī liù. | Tài hǎo le!
english: What day is it today? | Today is Saturday. | Great!
gloss: أَيُّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ الْيَوْمُ؟ | الْيَوْمُ السَّبْتُ. | رَائِعٌ!
gloss_reading: Ayyu yawmin huwa al-yawm? | Al-yawmu as-sabt. | Rāʾiʿ!

script: 这是你的吗？｜不是，是他的。
reading: Zhè shì nǐ de ma? | Bú shì, shì tā de.
english: Is this yours? | No, it's his.
gloss: هَلْ هٰذَا لَكَ؟ | لَا، هُوَ لَهُ.
gloss_reading: Hal hādhā lak? | Lā, huwa lah.

script: 你喜欢猫吗？｜我很喜欢猫。
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan māo ma? | Wǒ hěn xǐ huan māo.
english: Do you like cats? | I really like cats.
gloss: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْقِطَطَ؟ | أُحِبُّ الْقِطَطَ كَثِيرًا.
gloss_reading: Hal tuḥibbu al-qiṭaṭ? | Uḥibbu al-qiṭaṭa kathīran.

script: 你喜欢狗吗？｜不喜欢。
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan gǒu ma? | Bù xǐ huan.
english: Do you like dogs? | No.
gloss: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْكِلَابَ؟ | لَا.
gloss_reading: Hal tuḥibbu al-kilāb? | Lā.

script: 你喜欢看书吗？｜喜欢，我爱看书。
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan kàn shū ma? | Xǐ huan, wǒ ài kàn shū.
english: Do you like reading? | Yes, I love reading.
gloss: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْقِرَاءَةَ؟ | نَعَمْ، أُحِبُّ الْقِرَاءَةَ كَثِيرًا.
gloss_reading: Hal tuḥibbu al-qirāʾa? | Naʿam, uḥibbu al-qirāʾata kathīran.

script: 你想看电影吗？｜好！我们去看电影。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng kàn diàn yǐng ma? | Hǎo! Wǒ men qù kàn diàn yǐng.
english: Do you want to see a film? | Okay! We'll go see a film.
gloss: هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُشَاهِدَ فِيلْمًا؟ | حَسَنًا! لِنَذْهَبْ لِنُشَاهِدَ فِيلْمًا.
gloss_reading: Hal turīdu an tushāhida fīlman? | Ḥasanan! Linadhhab linushāhida fīlman.

script: 你想去北京吗？｜想！北京很大。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng qù běi jīng ma? | Xiǎng! Běi jīng hěn dà.
english: Do you want to go to Beijing? | Yes! Beijing is very big.
gloss: هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ إِلَى بِكِينَ؟ | نَعَمْ! بِكِينُ كَبِيرَةٌ جِدًّا.
gloss_reading: Hal turīdu an tadhhaba ilā bikīn? | Naʿam! Bikīnu kabīratun jiddan.

script: 你能来我家吗？｜能！什么时候？｜明天上午。
reading: Nǐ néng lái wǒ jiā ma? | Néng! Shén me shí hou? | Míng tiān shàng wǔ.
english: Can you come to my home? | Yes! When? | Tomorrow morning.
gloss: هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ إِلَى بَيْتِي؟ | نَعَمْ! مَتَى؟ | غَدًا صَبَاحًا.
gloss_reading: Hal tastaṭīʿu an taʾtiya ilā baytī? | Naʿam! Matā? | Ghadan ṣabāḥan.

script: 你的猫在哪儿？｜在桌子下面。
reading: Nǐ de māo zài nǎr? | Zài zhuō zi xià mian.
english: Where is your cat? | Under the table.
gloss: أَيْنَ قِطُّكَ؟ | تَحْتَ الطَّاوِلَةِ.
gloss_reading: Ayna qiṭṭuk? | Taḥta aṭ-ṭāwila.

script: 我没有钱。｜没关系，我有。
reading: Wǒ méi yǒu qián. | Méi guān xi, wǒ yǒu.
english: I don't have money. | It's okay, I do.
gloss: لَيْسَ عِنْدِي مَالٌ. | لَا بَأْسَ، عِنْدِي.
gloss_reading: Laysa ʿindī māl. | Lā baʾs, ʿindī.

script: 你想坐这个椅子吗？｜好的，谢谢。
reading: Nǐ xiǎng zuò zhè ge yǐ zi ma? | Hǎo de, xiè xie.
english: Do you want to sit in this chair? | Okay, thanks.
gloss: هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَجْلِسَ عَلَى هٰذَا الْكُرْسِيِّ؟ | حَسَنًا، شُكْرًا.
gloss_reading: Hal turīdu an tajlisa ʿalā hādhā al-kursiyy? | Ḥasanan, shukran.

script: 请坐！｜谢谢。
reading: Qǐng zuò! | Xiè xie.
english: Please sit! | Thanks.
gloss: تَفَضَّلْ بِالْجُلُوسِ! | شُكْرًا.
gloss_reading: Tafaḍḍal bi-l-julūs! | Shukran.

script: 你去医院吗？｜不去。
reading: Nǐ qù yī yuàn ma? | Bú qù.
english: Are you going to the hospital? | No.
gloss: هَلْ تَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمُسْتَشْفَى؟ | لَا.
gloss_reading: Hal tadhhabu ilā al-mustashfā? | Lā.

script: 我看见你了！｜你好！
reading: Wǒ kàn jiàn nǐ le! | Nǐ hǎo!
english: I see you! | Hello!
gloss: رَأَيْتُكَ! | مَرْحَبًا!
gloss_reading: Raʾaytuk! | Marḥaban!
